include(ExternalProject)

set(NLOHMANN_JSON_INSTALL_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/install)
set(NLOHMANN_JSON_INSTALL_DIR ${NLOHMANN_JSON_INSTALL_DIR} PARENT_SCOPE)
set(NLOHMANN_JSON_INCLUDE_DIR ${NLOHMANN_JSON_INSTALL_DIR}/include)
set(NLOHMANN_JSON_INCLUDE_DIR ${NLOHMANN_JSON_INCLUDE_DIR} PARENT_SCOPE)

ExternalProject_Add(
  nlohmann-json-project
  URL ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../libs/nlohmann-json
  CMAKE_ARGS
    -DJSON_BuildTests=OFF
    -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${NLOHMANN_JSON_INSTALL_DIR}
  INSTALL_DIR ${NLOHMANN_JSON_INSTALL_DIR}
)

file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${NLOHMANN_JSON_INCLUDE_DIR})

add_library(nlohmann-json INTERFACE IMPORTED GLOBAL)
set_property(
  TARGET nlohmann-json
  PROPERTY
  INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES ${NLOHMANN_JSON_INCLUDE_DIR}
)
add_dependencies(nlohmann-json nlohmann-json-project)
